prompt: Which creates a JButton labeled 'Submit' and adds an action listener?
choices: JButton btn = new JButton(); btn.setLabel("Submit"); btn.onClick(() -> save());
JButton btn = new JButton("Submit"); btn.addActionListener(e -> save());
Button btn = new Button("Submit"); btn.addActionListener(e -> save());
JButton btn = new JButton("Submit"); btn.setAction(() -> save());
explanation: JButton(String) sets the label. addActionListener(ActionListener) wires up the event handler. A lambda (e -> save()) works because ActionListener is a functional interface. Option C uses AWT Button, not Swing. Option D — setAction takes an Action object, not a lambda directly.
